architecture.description: what stands: the structure a system HAS, rather than one being proposed

design.description: a change being proposed; what it is, is written in the doc beside it. `proposed` and `decided` carry its lifecycle

design_new.title: Propose a design
design_new.description: Write a change down so it can be argued with: an entity with design{}, doc{title, body} and proposed{} on it. Who proposed it and when are stamped from the caller, never passed as arguments.

title.description: what it proposes, in a line

project.description: the project it is filed under

design_decide.title: Decide a design
design_decide.description: Record the decision on a proposal: approved, or declined. The decider is whoever is calling — stamped from the caller, so an agent's own decision is recorded as the agent's, and as an owner's only when the owner is the one calling.

verdict.description: approved, rejected, or approved once these changes are made

review.description: one person's assessment of a design: the verdict, and the comment beside it
